description: A small web application used to draw polygons of mine areas at a given set of locations on satellite imagery, released by the FINEPRINT project. The Zenodo software record describes it in one line as "a web application to poligonize mine-areas in a given set of locations"; it is archived from the GitHub repository fineprint-global/app-mining-area-polygonization. Version 1.2 was published on 28 February 2020 by Victor Maus of the Ecological Economics group at the Vienna University of Economics and Business and a co-author, as a downloadable ZIP of source code of about 0.2 MB, open access under a licence the record labels "other open". Coverage is any location list supplied by the user. Caveats: the record gives no documentation, language or deployment details, so these are not stated on the page read. For simulation it is the digitising tool behind the global-scale mining polygons, which others can reuse to map mine sites in new regions before assessing their exposure. Related catalogue records include the Maus global-scale mining polygons and the onset of mining operations layer.
